scope: Exact musical graph, source state, all native parameter commands and once-only source cleanup are mandatory. Each cleanup window begins at the native quantum containing oscillator stop and ends two render quanta after the latest actual/reference disconnect currentTime. Only that filter tail may vary by at most two times the original .0001 final gain envelope per ending note. Raw recordings and callback timestamps remain immutable. This does not widen other Sound-family tests.
